snippet.title: Colorami - Teaser Trailer #2
snippet.description:
Here's our new teaser trailer prepared for the #PitchYaGame event!

Repaint platforms on the map to solve asymmetric puzzles for two players. Cooperate, plan, solve, experiment with colors, and restart freely if need be. A vibrant pixel art world and its spirits need your help.

Try out our demo and consider Wishlisting: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4001780/Colorami/

Music: Level 2 by Chris Logsdon
From Ambient Puzzle Music/SFX Pack
https://chrislsound.itch.io/ambient-puzzle

#indiegames #videogames #gaming #gametrailer
